usage: The word '垃圾' is used as a noun to refer to rubbish or garbage.
It can be used to describe waste material thrown away at home or in public places.
'垃圾' can be a countable or uncountable noun depending on the context.
You can say '扔垃圾' (throw rubbish) or '垃圾桶' (rubbish bin) to talk about discarding or containing rubbish.
It can also be used metaphorically to describe something worthless or bad.
